title: Teacher of Mathematics
company: La Côte International School (Nord Anglia Education)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Fondata nel 2008, La Côte International School è una scuola giornaliera co-educativa con base in lingua inglese per studenti dai 3 ai 18 anni. Situata a Aubonne, Svizzera.A poca distanza da Ginevra e Losanna.La nostra scuola ospita quasi 400 studenti che rappresentano una varietà di culture e di background.

In LCIS offriamo un mix unico di educazione internazionale e forti legami tra comunità locali con percorsi inglesi, francesi e bilingui, che portano al Programma Internazionale di Diploma Baccalaureate (IBDP) riconosciuto a livello globale. Attraverso collaborazioni esclusive con Juilliard, MIT e UNICEF, offriamo opportunità arricchenti che ispirano gli studenti a prosperare accademicamente, creativamente e personalmente. E' in questo ambiente dinamico che vi invitiamo a unirvi al nostro team come:

Descrizione del lavoro

Maestro di matematica

100%. agosto 2026 a luglio 2028

Responsabilità:

• Fornire l'insegnamento e l'apprendimento della Matematica durante la scuola secondaria in modo efficace

• Partecipare alla progettazione, sviluppo, attuazione e revisione dei programmi secondari inferiori, IGCSE e IBDP Mathematics

• Liacciare i responsabili del curriculum per garantire l'effettiva consegna del curriculum a classi specifiche, compresa la selezione delle risorse e la gestione efficiente in classe

• Identificare gli studenti SEN e lavorare in collaborazione per garantire che le loro esigenze siano soddisfatte

• Capacità di condurre progetti e lavorare in modo indipendente

• Promuovere la salute e la sicurezza delle classi assegnate

• Partecipare allo sviluppo professionale e contribuire alla formazione/incontri regolari del personale

• Contribuire ad un programma di escursioni, escursioni, gite in campo e attività extracurriculari

• Migliorare la posizione professionale del corpo docente

• Contribuire allo sviluppo di un atteggiamento positivo tra la Matematica e la comunità in generale attraverso relazioni di cooperazione, pubblicazioni, concorsi ecc.

Qualificazioni e competenze:

• Laurea in materie correlate e PGCE o equivalente

• Proven track record di eccellenza nell'insegnamento con almeno tre anni di esperienza. idealmente in un ambiente internazionale

• L'esperienza di insegnamento IGCSE e IBDP Matematica preferita ma MYPS e/o A esperienza di livello un minimo.

• Eccellente capacità comunicative e giocatore di squadra

• Capacità di condividere la passione per l'insegnamento

• avere la capacità di gestire un carico di lavoro diversificato ed esigente

• Saper ispirare le classi miste di cultura e capacità, creando opportunità di apprendimento impegnative e coinvolgenti per tutti gli studenti

• Saper sostenere le esigenze degli studenti in materia di apprendimento e pastorale

• Cancellare i casellari giudiziari

Se condividi la nostra passione per l'educazione e vuoi unirti al nostro team, ti preghiamo di fare domanda direttamente online attraverso il nostro sito web.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Founded in 2008, La Côte International School is a co-educational, English-language-based day school for students aged 3 to 18. Situated in Aubonne, Switzerland—within easy reach of Geneva and Lausanne—our school is home to nearly 400 students representing a variety of cultures and backgrounds.

At LCIS, we offer a unique blend of international education and strong local community ties with English, French, and bilingual pathways, leading to the globally recognized International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme (IBDP). Through exclusive collaborations with Juilliard, MIT, and UNICEF, we deliver enriching opportunities that inspire students to thrive academically, creatively, and personally. It is in this dynamic environment that we invite you to join our team as:

Job Description

Teacher of Mathematics

100% – August 2026 to July 2028

Responsibilities:

• Deliver the teaching and learning of Mathematics throughout the secondary school effectively

• Participate in the design, development, implementation and review of the lower secondary, IGCSE and IBDP Mathematics programmes

• Liaise with the curriculum leaders to ensure effective delivery of the curriculum to specified classes, including selecting resources and managing them efficiently in the classroom

• Identifying SEN students and working collaboratively to ensure their needs are met

• Ability to lead on projects and work independently

• Promote the health and safety of assigned classes

• Participate in professional development and contribute to regular staff training/meetings

• Contribute to a programme of trips, excursions, fieldtrips and extracurricular activities

• Enhance the professional standing of the teaching body

• Contribute to the development of a positive attitude between Mathematics and the wider community through cooperative relations, publications, competitions etc.

Qualifications and skills:

• Subject related degree and PGCE or equivalent

• Proven track record of excellence in teaching with at least three years’ experience, ideally in an international environment

• Experience of teaching IGCSE and IBDP Mathematics preferred but MYPS and/or A level experience a minimum.

• Excellent communication skills and team player

• Ability to share your passion for teaching

• Have the ability to manage a diverse and demanding workload

• Be able to inspire mixed culture and ability classes, by creating challenging and engaging learning opportunities for all students

• Be able to support student needs in learning and pastoral matters

• Clear criminal records

If you share our passion for education and would like to join our team, please apply directly online through our website.

Fondata nel 2008, La Côte International School ("LCIS") è una scuola di lingua inglese che accoglie quasi 450 studenti di età compresa tra 2 e 18 anni. Immersa tra i vigneti e i frutteti di Aubonne, in Svizzera, La Côte International School è vicina a Ginevra e Losanna.

Coordinatore dei trasporti scolastici e concierge versatile

- Coordinare percorsi, orari e assegnazioni di veicoli.
- Gestire la nostra piattaforma di trasporto (Vectare / SchoolsBuddy).

- Partecipare alla manutenzione generale degli edifici e degli spazi esterni.
- Eseguire varie attività di pulizia, logistica, pulizia e manutenzione di primo livello.

Il tuo profilo:

- Patente D1, OACP e carta di qualificazione del conducente valide.
- Ottima padronanza della lingua francese e buona conoscenza dell'inglese.
- Comodità con gli strumenti IT e le attività amministrative.
- Senso di organizzazione, servizio e responsabilità.
- Capacità di lavorare in autonomia e gestire eventi imprevisti.
- L'esperienza nel concierge, nella manutenzione leggera o nel supporto logistico sarebbe un vantaggio.

Sei interessato a unirti al nostro team? Ti invitiamo a inviare il tuo dossier di candidatura completo esclusivamente tramite il nostro sito web.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Description

Founded in 2008, La Côte International School ("LCiti") is an English-language school, which welcomes nearly 450 students aged 2 to 18. Nestled between the vineyards and orchards of Aubonne, Switzerland, the international school of La Côte is located close to Geneva and Lausanne.

We offer our students unique international learning experiences inspired by our collaborations with Juilliard, MIT and UNICEF. Our custom-made curriculum offers our students the opportunity to follow a course in English, French or bilingual leading to the International Baccalaureate Diploma (IBDP) program, which is internationally renowned. It is in this dynamic environment that we invite you to join our team:

Job Description

School transport coordinator and multi-purpose janitor

70-100% - from August 2026 - June 2028 (renewable)

Within our international school, you will play a key role in the organization and proper functioning of the school transportation service. This function combines responsibility for coordination, driving and relationship with families to ensure a safe, reliable and effective service for our students.

Your missions:

- Coordinate the routes, schedules and assignments of vehicles. - Manage our transport platform (Vectare / SchoolBuddy). - Be the main contact point for parents, students and drivers on transport issues. - Ensure safe journeys in case of absences. - Ensure the administrative and regulatory follow-up of the service. - Ensure the proper condition and compliance of the vehicle fleet. - Work closely with the Site Coordinator and the administrative teams.

- Participate in the general maintenance of buildings and outdoor spaces. - Perform various tasks of concierge, logistics, cleaning and maintenance of first level.

Your profile:

- Permit D1, OACP and valid driver qualification card. - Excellent mastery of French and good knowledge of English. - Good knowledge with computer tools and administrative tasks. - Meaning of organization, service and responsibilities. - Ability to work independently and manage unforeseen events. - Experience in concierge, light maintenance or logistical support would be an asset. - Ability to perform routine maintenance and small repairs independently. - Activity rate based on manual skills.

- Unspecified judicial case and work permit valid in Switzerland.

Interested in joining our team? We invite you to submit your complete application package exclusively via our website.

Within our international school, you will contribute to the daily operation of the school by providing transportation for students and support for concierge, maintenance and logistics activities of the site.

Your missions

- Safe morning and afternoon school tours. - Transport related to excursions, school trips and school activities. - Ensure the proper condition of the vehicles: regular checks, cleaning and routine maintenance. - Participate in the general maintenance of buildings and outdoor areas. - Perform various tasks of concierge, logistics, cleaning and first level maintenance. - Assist in the preparation of school events (shows, assemblies).

- Contribute to the installation, movement and assembly of furniture or equipment as required. - Work with the Site Manager to ensure a safe, functional and welcoming environment for students and staff.

Your profile

- Valid Swiss Professional Licence D or D1. - Valid ACO and driver qualification card. - Good command of French; English knowledge is an asset. - Service sense, excellent relational and taste of team work. - Ability to perform practical work and manual tasks. - Technical training (CFC operating agent, electrician, plumber, carpenter or equivalent) or experience deemed equivalent, an asset. - Ability to perform routine maintenance and small repairs independently.

- Time flexibility required due to morning and afternoon school tours. - Auto-Studies, reliability, discretion and organizational sense. - Unrefined criminal records.

What we offer

- International and dynamic environment. - Professional development opportunities. - Competitive pay and benefits.

Contact

Interested in joining our team? Please send us your complete file in electronic format only via our website.

Beschreibung

Die 2008 gegründete La Côte International School („LCIS“) ist eine englischsprachige Schule, die fast 450 Schüler im Alter von 3 bis 18 Jahren willkommen heißt. Die La Côte International School liegt inmitten der Weinberge und Obstgärten von Aubonne in der Schweiz, in der Nähe von Genf und Lausanne.

Wir bieten unseren Studierenden beispiellose internationale Lernerfahrungen, inspiriert durch unsere Zusammenarbeit mit Juilliard, MIT und UNICEF. Unser maßgeschneidertes Studienprogramm bietet unseren Studierenden die Möglichkeit, einen englischsprachigen, französischen oder zweisprachigen Weg zu beschreiten, der zum international renommierten International Baccalaureate Diploma Program (IBDP) führt. In diesem dynamischen Umfeld laden wir Sie ein, unserem Team beizutreten:

Stellenbeschreibung

Schulfahrer und vielseitiger Hausmeister

100 % – von August 2026 – Juni 2028 (erneuerbar)

Innerhalb unserer internationalen Schule tragen Sie zum reibungslosen täglichen Funktionieren der Einrichtung bei, indem Sie für den Schülertransport sorgen und die Hausmeister-, Wartungs- und Logistikaktivitäten vor Ort unterstützen.

Ihre Missionen

- Gewährleisten Sie einen sicheren Schulgang am Morgen und Nachmittag.
- Durchführung von Transporten im Zusammenhang mit Ausflügen, Schulausflügen und Gründungsaktivitäten.
- Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Fahrzeuge in gutem Zustand sind: regelmäßige Kontrollen, Reinigung und routinemäßige Wartung.
- Mitwirkung bei der allgemeinen Instandhaltung von Gebäuden und Außenräumen.
- Führen Sie verschiedene Hausmeister-, Logistik-, Reinigungs- und Wartungsaufgaben der ersten Ebene aus.
- Helfen Sie bei der Vorbereitung von Schulveranstaltungen (Shows, Versammlungen).
- Bei Bedarf bei der Installation, Bewegung und Montage von Möbeln oder Geräten mitwirken.
- Arbeiten Sie mit dem Standortleiter zusammen, um eine sichere, funktionale und einladende Umgebung für Studenten und Mitarbeiter zu gewährleisten.

Ihr Profil

- Gültiger Schweizer Berufsausweis D oder D1.
- Aktuelles OACP und gültige Fahrerqualifikationskarte.
- Gute Französischkenntnisse; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
- Servicebereitschaft, ausgezeichnete zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und eine Vorliebe für Teamarbeit.
- Komfort bei praktischer Arbeit und manuellen Aufgaben.
- Technische Ausbildung (CFC als Betriebsvertreter, Elektriker, Klempner, Zimmermann oder gleichwertig) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung, von Vorteil.
- Fähigkeit zur selbstständigen Durchführung routinemäßiger Wartungsarbeiten und kleinerer Reparaturen.
- Aufgrund der Schulführungen am Vormittag und Nachmittag ist Flexibilität bei der Planung erforderlich.
- Autonomie, Zuverlässigkeit, Diskretion und Organisationssinn.
- Leere Strafregisterauszüge.

Was wir bieten

- Internationales und dynamisches Umfeld.
- Möglichkeiten zur beruflichen Weiterentwicklung.
- Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und Sozialleistungen.

Kontakt

Sind Sie daran interessiert, unserem Team beizutreten? Bitte senden Sie uns Ihre vollständige Datei ausschließlich in elektronischer Form über unsere Website.
